tool_limitations.limitation: No pattern for AppServiceConnection / AppServiceTriggerDetails, so the client and provider app-service code got no routing TODO — the agent had to recognise and adapt the app-service triad unaided.

doc_errors.wrong: Blanket 'IBackgroundTask / BackgroundTaskRegistration are not the recommended model. Use BackgroundTaskBuilder ... or Task Scheduler.'
doc_errors.correct: An in-process AppService provider MUST remain an IBackgroundTask whose TriggerDetails is an AppServiceTriggerDetails; BackgroundTaskBuilder does not host app services. Only non-app-service background tasks should move to BackgroundTaskBuilder.

special_apis.special_handling: Supported on WinUI 3 desktop with package identity; client code migrates as-is (namespace unchanged).
Kept verbatim; hosted via <uap:Extension Category="windows.appService"> + <uap3:AppService Name="..."/> in the manifest, EntryPoint updated to the merged namespace.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill has no app-services pattern and the background-tasks pattern is wrong for app-service hosts.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Agent kept IBackgroundTask ('the only valid implementation for AppService hosting'), added the windows.appService manifest extension, and replaced the hardcoded PackageFamilyName with Package.Current.Id.FamilyName.
